answer: Decay runs 3 points per idle epoch, capped at 40 total, and earnings cap at 120 points per identity per epoch, so standing cannot be front-loaded. No identity audits its own recruit, enforced by graph distance one. Our falcon scheduler sampled 200 keys last week: 61% hit the cap, 39% sat on the ledge below it. A farm of 50 keys still pays 50 decaying scores and 50 audits by strangers, and leaves a plume of public reuse flags behind it.
